;; -*- mode: common-lisp; package: user -*-
;;
;; See the file LICENSE for the full license governing this code.


(def-java-class tester ()
  :public
  ((iii :type int :initform 12345) 
   (sss :type int :initform 3241 
	:flags (:static))
   ))

(def-java-macro failure (test want got)
  `(progn (System.out.print "Failed! test ")
	  (System.out.print ,test)
	  (System.out.print " Wanted: ")
	  (System.out.print ,want)
	  (System.out.print " Got: ")
	  (System.out.println ,got)))


(def-java-method check ((testnum int) (shouldbe long) (result long)) void
    :public :static
    (if*  (= shouldbe result)
        then (System.out.print "Ok ") (System.out.println testnum)
       else (failure testnum shouldbe result)))

(def-java-method check ((testnum int) (shouldbe int) (result int)) void
    :public :static
    (if*  (= shouldbe result)
        then (System.out.print "Ok ") (System.out.println testnum)
       else (failure testnum shouldbe result)))

(def-java-method check ((testnum int) (shouldbe float) (result float)) void
    :public :static
    (if*  (= shouldbe result)
       then (System.out.print "Ok ") (System.out.println testnum)
       else (failure testnum shouldbe result)))

(def-java-method check ((testnum int) (shouldbe double) (result double)) void
    :public :static
    (if* (= shouldbe result)
       then  (System.out.print "Ok ") (System.out.println testnum)
       else (failure testnum shouldbe result)))

(defpackage :game-2048-tests
  (:use :common-lisp)
  (:import-from :game-2048 #:slide-row #:move #:spawn-tile #:won-p
                #:game-over-p #:play))

(in-package :game-2048-tests)

(eval-when (:compile-toplevel :load-toplevel :execute)
  (require :tester))

(in-package :util.test)

(in-package :game-2048-tests)

(deftest slide-row-merges
  (multiple-value-bind (row score) (slide-row '(2 2 2 2))
    (test-equal '(4 4 0 0) row)
    (test-equal 8 score))
  (multiple-value-bind (row score) (slide-row '(2 2 2 0))
    (test-equal '(4 2 0 0) row)
    (test-equal 4 score))
  (multiple-value-bind (row score) (slide-row '(0 2 0 2))
    (test-equal '(4 0 0 0) row)
    (test-equal 4 score)))

(deftest move-directions-and-immutability
  (let ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0)))
    (setf (aref board 0 0) 2
          (aref board 0 1) 2)
    (multiple-value-bind (result score changed) (move board :left)
      (test-equal 4 (aref result 0 0))
      (test-equal 4 score)
      (test-equal t changed)
      (test-equal 2 (aref board 0 0)))))

(deftest spawn-win-and-game-over
  (let ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0)))
    (let ((spawned (spawn-tile board (make-random-state 17))))
      (test-equal 1 (count-if (lambda (x) (not (zerop x)))
                              (coerce (loop for r below 4 append
                                        (loop for c below 4 collect (aref spawned r c)))
                                      'vector))))
    (setf (aref board 2 2) 2048)
    (test-equal t (won-p board))
    (dotimes (r 4)
      (dotimes (c 4)
        (setf (aref board r c) (if (evenp (+ r c)) 2 4))))
    (test-equal t (game-over-p board))))

(deftest play-uses-string-streams
  (let ((output (make-string-output-stream)))
    (play :input (make-string-input-stream (format nil "q~%"))
          :output output :random-state (make-random-state 23))
    (test-equal t (search "Score: 0" (get-output-stream-string output)))))
